## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ is a treatise on the famous Huáyán-school *jìng dēng* 鏡燈 ("mirror-lamp") image — the doctrine of mutual interreflection between the cosmic Vairocana Buddha and all phenomena, classically expounded by [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng using the imperial gilded-lion image (cf. *[Jīn shī zǐ zhāng yún jiān lèi jiě](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0097)*) and reproduced visually in the Tang-onwards iconographic tradition of mirror-and-lamp arrangements in monastic shrines.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1660 – 1715) reflects [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ's mature scholarly activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1028) collection.
